Locked apps ask for your fingerprint, face or screen lock wherever Chikku opens them: home, dock, folders, drawer, search, gestures, cards, shortcuts and App info. Their shortcuts are hidden.

There is no separate Chikku PIN to guess or reset: Android checks your screen lock and limits attempts. Turning a lock off, or changing these settings, needs the same check. Restoring a Chikku backup never removes locks.\n\nA launcher can only guard what it opens. A locked app can still be reached from its notifications, Recents, its widgets, another launcher or Android\'s Settings, and clearing Chikku\'s storage removes the locks. For apps that must stay sealed, use Android\'s Private space or a work profile.
